_what: This browser as a place the person's Trillion can run work (placement:your-browser, records/workshop-placement-records.json): extension/src/browser-runs.mjs publishes the `agent` card that placement names, looks for work handed to it every `every_minutes` (sending its card again every `publish_every_minutes`), and answers each run with the function `tools` names for its tool id. `capacity` is how many runs it takes at once and how long that claim lasts. `read_page` is how a page is read: opened in a window of its own that is not brought forward, read once loaded and `settle_ms` has passed, at most `most_seconds` in all and `max_text` characters, then closed. Every word an AI reads is under `words`.

agent.name: This browser
agent.description: Reads web pages through the person's own browser, signed in as them, so pages that need their sign-in or refuse servers can still be read.

words.needs_url: Send the page's address as url (http or https).
words.not_read: This browser opened {url} but could not read it: {error}
words.too_slow: {url} did not finish loading in this browser within {seconds} seconds.
words.needs_steps: Send the steps to do as steps: a list of { do, target, ... } (see the actions this browser knows).
